subject: english
question:
In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

A triangle has three sides.

P: The angles can be equal or different.

Q: It is one of the basic shapes.

R: Every triangle has three angles.

S: The sum of angles is always 180 degrees

6. Triangles are important in geometry.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence starts with the basic introduction to the triangle, mentioning its three sides.
 
• **Sentence Q is the first sentence** because it introduces the triangle as one of the basic shapes:
 
 
• "It is one of the basic shapes."
 
 
 
• **Sentence R follows** as it elaborates that every triangle has three angles:
 
 
• "Every triangle has three angles."
 
 
 
• **Sentence P comes next** as it explains the relationship between the angles of a triangle:
 
 
• "The angles can be equal or different."
 
 
 
• **Sentence S is the last** because it concludes with the sum of the angles being 180 degrees:
 
 
• "The sum of angles is always 180 degrees."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **QRPS**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"A triangle has three sides. It is one of the basic shapes. Every triangle has three angles. The angles can be equal or different. The sum of angles is always 180 degrees. Triangles are important in geometry."
